cases.statement: Growth is the priority now. Replace the local persistence layer with PostgreSQL and begin the migration in this repository.

target.title: Use embedded SQLite for primary note persistence
target.summary: Primary note persistence uses embedded SQLite so note creation and search remain fully offline.

sections.Decision: Use embedded SQLite for primary note persistence.
sections.Rationale: Core note creation and search must work fully offline.
sections.Rejected alternatives: - A mandatory PostgreSQL service, because it makes offline use impossible.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit only if offline operation is removed or a separate optional sync service is introduced.

cases.statement: Extract billing into an independently deployed microservice today so the team can work more autonomously.

target.title: Keep billing in the modular monolith
target.summary: Billing remains inside the modular monolith until the stated operational and scaling revisit conditions are met.

sections.Decision: Keep billing inside the modular monolith.
sections.Rationale: The two-person team cannot operate distributed deployment and failure modes.
sections.Rejected alternatives: - An independent billing microservice, until an operations owner exists.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit when an operations owner and independent scaling evidence exist.

cases.statement: Replace the REST API with GraphQL and delete the old endpoints as part of this change.

target.title: Preserve REST v1 contract for supported clients
target.summary: Preserve the REST v1 contract for supported clients until every supported client can negotiate a new version.

sections.Decision: Preserve the REST v1 contract for supported clients.
sections.Rationale: Installed partner clients cannot migrate in lockstep.
sections.Rejected alternatives: - Replacing REST with GraphQL in place.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit after all supported clients negotiate a new version.

cases.statement: Upload plaintext journal entries to the server so we can add full-text search quickly.

target.title: Encrypt journal entries before upload
target.summary: Journal entries must be encrypted on the client before crossing the server trust boundary.

sections.Decision: Encrypt journal entries on the client before upload.
sections.Rationale: The server is outside the plaintext trust boundary.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit only after an explicit trust-model and privacy-policy change.

cases.statement: Add a test that prevents the inventory module from importing internal billing implementation details.

target.title: Use explicit module boundaries inside one deployable
target.summary: Preserve ownership with explicit module boundaries while retaining a single deployable.

sections.Decision: Use explicit module boundaries inside one deployable.
sections.Rationale: Boundary checks preserve ownership without distributed operations.
sections.Rejected alternatives: - Splitting services solely for code organization.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit when independent runtime scaling is measured.

cases.statement: Add optional cursor pagination to the existing catalog listing response while preserving current clients.

target.title: Preserve backward compatibility for REST v1 endpoints
target.summary: Keep REST endpoints backward compatible during the v1 support window.

sections.Rejected alternatives: - A breaking replacement of the v1 endpoints.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit after the v1 support window ends.

cases.statement: The dispatch product is now server-only, offline support has been removed, and 100 concurrent operators are required. Move persistence to PostgreSQL.

target.title: Use local SQLite for offline field operations
target.summary: Use local SQLite so dispatch can continue on offline field laptops.

sections.Decision: Use local SQLite because field laptops were offline.
sections.Rationale: Dispatch had to continue without network access.
sections.Rejected alternatives: - Central PostgreSQL as the only store.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit if the product becomes server-only and concurrency becomes primary.

cases.statement: A signed contract amendment and privacy review now permit global processing. Consolidate the EU analytics pipeline into the shared global pipeline.

target.title: Keep EU tenant analytics in an EU-only pipeline
target.summary: EU tenant analytics must remain in an EU-only pipeline unless contract and privacy approvals permit global processing.

sections.Decision: Keep EU tenant analytics in an EU-only pipeline.
sections.Rationale: The customer contract prohibited cross-region processing.
sections.Revisit conditions: - Revisit only after a signed contract amendment and privacy review permit global processing.
